findings_resolved.correction: Queued setup is caught centrally with reset flags and fail-closed state; begin checks its current Connecting generation before guarded connect.

review_conclusion: No remaining concrete source blocker in the bounded initial channel. Socket/timer work and synchronous internal failures never directly deliver public callbacks. Queued current-state delivery uses QPointer and generation/state checks around the reentrant state signal, with no access after final signals. EOF, malformed/bounded frames, cancellation and explicit restart withdraw date observation. No automatic router or payload authority is added.
